retry_contract.allowed_semantic_delta: Recognize MediaWiki's observed top-level plural errors array as an API-error envelope. Require a nonempty list of objects with nonempty codes; a single unique frozen retryable code such as maxlag follows the existing API retry and Retry-After ceilings, while malformed or multiple distinct codes are terminal. All success, scope, frame, parser, transport, retry, and all-or-none publication rules remain unchanged.

source_frame_contract.canonicalization_rule: Consume the exact ordered broad candidate JSONL without title rewriting; retain every unique creator-item-filename row; build numeric-QID-sorted Wikidata batches and total-order case-folded Commons batches.
source_frame_contract.deduplication_rule: No physical-work or capture deduplication occurs. Duplicate item-file rows are forbidden; multiple files for one item remain separate rows.
source_frame_contract.consequence: This route measures current material-statement, current-P18, rights-marker, MIME, and reported-geometry attrition for the complete broad discovery output. It cannot establish museum authority, physical-work identity, content eligibility, image decode, or active-study admission.

request_contract.user_agent: latent-art-bench/0.1 painter-feature-generation-v1 broad media followup r2 (+https://github.com/isingmodel/latent-art-bench)
request_contract.plural_api_error_rule: A top-level errors value must be a nonempty list of objects whose code values are nonempty strings. Exactly one unique code is normalized to api_error_code and classified only by the frozen retryable_api_error_codes list. Malformed plural errors or multiple distinct codes are terminal API errors. The raw response remains the complete provider receipt.
request_contract.terminal_rule: All 182 exact batches must reach one parser-complete success inside this new census; no R1 success is reused. Listed transient failures may retry only within frozen ceilings. Redirects, normalization, missing members, continuation, schema drift, unknown network outcome, interruption, malformed plural errors, or over-ceiling Retry-After are terminal and require another reviewed census ID. No partial manifest is emitted.

screening_contract.authority_rule: Wikidata and Commons remain discovery/delivery evidence. No row is admitted until an authoritative holding or catalogue record independently confirms exact attribution, oil on canvas, work identity, and the media reuse basis.
